newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Graboplast to buy 30,000 own shares.
newsitem.headline: Graboplast to buy 30,000 own shares.

text.p: Hungarian home improvement product maker Graboplast said on Thursday that it had commissioned a brokerage for buying 30,000 Graboplast ordinary shares from the "A" series on its behalf.
Graboplast said in a statement in the official gazette of the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) that the shares should be bought at the price on the BSE.
The statement did not disclose details of the deal's timing. Graboplast officials were not immediately available for comment.
Graboplast closed at 4,350 forints on the BSE on Wednesday, compared with 4,700 forints early last week and 4,380 forints on Monday.

News about a police investigation against Graboplast were published on Monday. The police started investigation against Graboplast after it had found materials, allegedly including hazardous waste, at Graboplast plants.
Graboplast said the waste it had at its plants was not hazardous and asked the police to finish the investigation.
Graboplast boosted its after-tax profit to 868 million forints in the January-September period of this year from 359.3 million in the same period of 1995.
